rules.coverage_conditions: Lessors before the start of a tenancy
rules.exemptions: Licensed brokers (254 C.M.R. 7) with written fee notice
rules.title: Massachusetts bar on landlord application fees
rules.requirement: Before a tenancy begins, a landlord may charge only first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit and a lock-change fee. Application, screening and similar fees are forbidden for landlords; licensed brokers may charge fees under 254 CMR 7.
rules.key_value: no landlord application fee; only first, last, security, locks
rules.quoted_span: no lessor may require payment for anything except first, last, security, and locks (MGL Ch 186 Section 15B).

notes: No effective date on page ('law has been in effect since the 1970s'); effective_date null. Broker rules 254 C.M.R. 7 folded into the same record.
